info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Retail Orders Items-v2-spec
info.description: The Retail Orders Items Listing API provides access to a comprehensive list of items associated with retail orders, allowing users to efficiently manage their inventory and fulfillment processes. This API enables businesses to retrieve detailed information about each item's availability, status, and relevant order details. Typical consumers of this API include e-commerce platforms, inventory management systems, and retailers looking to streamline their operations. By utilizing this endpoint, developers can integrate effective order tracking capabilities into their applications, enhancing the overall shopping experience.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch all items related to current orders. You can use this to view the details of each item including quantity, price, and associated order information.

requestBody.description: Retrieves a collection of order items based on the specified criteria. The body of the request should be structured according to the defined schema to ensure the correct data is processed.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the list of order items.

ListRetailOrdersItemsRequest.description: This schema represents the string type payload expected for the GET request body related to orders items.

ListRetailOrdersItemsResponse_200.title: Order Item Response

status.description: Indicates if the operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: A unique reference number for the order.

processingTimeMs.description: The processing time of the request in milliseconds.

message.description: Additional information regarding the order or operation.

audit.description: Audit information related to the order.

ListRetailOrdersItemsResponse_200.description: Response schema for retrieving order item details.

x-processing-time.description: Indicates the time (in milliseconds) taken to process the request. This metric helps in assessing the performance of the API response.
